title: Phone/SMS Test Number Purchase Review Gate
blockers: Complete QL-023 non-secret manual setup evidence before purchase review.
Confirm exactly one provider for the first test number: voipms, telnyx, or twilio.
Confirm the first target use: RosieDazzlers, DevilnDove, or shared hub testing.
Confirm the approved monthly/pay-as-you-go CAD test budget.
Confirm the provider account exists outside the repository.
Record a non-secret provider account reference label.
Confirm where credentials are stored without committing credential values.
Confirm provider portal purchase screen review.
Confirm SMS/compliance review before buying any SMS-capable number.
Confirm screenshots, invoices, ownership proof, and provider documents are stored outside the repository.
Record only a non-secret region/type label for the candidate number, not the actual number.
Confirm expected capability: voice_only, sms_capable, or voice_and_sms.
Record the estimated monthly CAD cost as a non-negative number.
Record the estimated one-time/setup CAD cost as a non-negative number.
Owner approval is required before one manual test-number purchase.
allowedManualActionsAfterApproval: Manually purchase one new disposable Canadian test number in the chosen provider portal.
Store purchase proof, invoices, screenshots, and number ownership evidence outside this repository.
Record only redacted non-secret purchase evidence in the next build.
Keep phone/SMS webhooks, SMS sending, call recording, and AI auto-send disabled after purchase.
forbiddenActions: Do not commit the actual purchased phone number.
Do not commit provider API keys, SIP credentials, tokens, passwords, webhook secrets, screenshots, invoices, or ownership documents.
Do not port any existing number.
Do not forward any existing number.
Do not enable phone webhooks, SMS sending, call recording, or AI auto-send.
Do not connect live website forms or real customer data to the phone/SMS path yet.
nextSafeAction: Complete purchase-review blockers while keeping live phone/SMS disabled.
